# Vincent Azé

> Vincent Azé is Managing Partner at Kuma Partners and a former CRO. He helps founders and leadership teams of scale-ups, from Series A to C+, resolve executive friction and decision latency.

Canonical site: https://vincentaze.com
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/vincentaze/

## Entity summary

Vincent Azé: Managing Partner, Kuma Partners. Former Chief Revenue Officer. Independent executive advisor and leadership sparring partner from March 2017 to February 2023.

## Ecosystem routing

- Kuma Partners (the firm, 14-Day Leadership Friction Diagnostic): https://kuma.partners
- Leadership team offsites: https://kuma.partners/offsite
- The Round (peer advisory for founders and CEOs, Barcelona): https://theround.kuma.partners
- Dr. Sven Mulfinger (partner at Kuma Partners, one-to-one executive advisory): https://mulfinger.com

## Disambiguation

Vincent Azé is a person. Kuma Partners is the firm he leads as Managing Partner. This site is his personal site and points to the firm's pages for offers and enquiries.
